b1-quantifiers.title: Quantifiers: har, hamma, ba'zi
b1-quantifiers.explanation: Har combines with a singular noun for "every": har kuni (every day), har bir odam (each and every person). Hamma stands alone for "everyone/everything": hamma biladi (everyone knows). Ba'zi precedes a noun for "some": ba'zi odamlar (some people).
b1-quantifiers.fact: Har always takes a SINGULAR noun even though its meaning is distributive/plural in effect (har bir odam, never har odamlar) -- much like English "every day" stays singular even while covering all days, Uzbek locks the noun to singular grammatically no matter how universal the meaning is.

dialogue.en: I wonder if everyone knows about this.

b1-purpose-sin-uchun.title: Purpose (3rd person): -sin uchun
b1-purpose-sin-uchun.explanation: To express purpose involving a third party ("so that he/she would..."), Uzbek combines the jussive -sin ("let him/her ~") with uchun: u tushunsin uchun tushuntirdim (I explained so that he/she would understand).
b1-purpose-sin-uchun.fact: This reuses -sin from its more basic "let him/her do it" command sense (kelsin! -- "let him/her come!") -- purpose-for-a-third-party in Uzbek is literally built as "so that [let-it-happen], I did X", folding a mild command into a purpose clause.

dialogue.en: Why did you write in such detail?
I wrote in detail so that everyone would understand.

items.en: I run every morning.
Everyone knew this news.
Some people don't believe this.

items.uz: Har bir talaba imtihon topshirishi kerak.
items.en: Every student must take the exam.
Everything is ready.
Some books are very expensive.
Every time, he/she is late.
Everyone gathered here.
Some days are very difficult.

items.uz: Har bir ish o'z vaqtida bajarilishi kerak.
items.en: Every task must be completed on time.
Everyone was happy.
I couldn't find answers to some questions.
I explained so that he/she would understand.
I raised my voice so that everyone would hear.
I turned off the light so that the child would sleep.
I wrote a letter so that he/she would come.

items.uz: Hammaga yetsin uchun ko'proq ovqat tayyorladik.
items.en: We prepared more food so that there would be enough for everyone.

items.uz: U xotirjam bo'lsin uchun unga rost gapni aytmadim.
items.en: I didn't tell him/her the truth so that he/she would stay calm.
I helped so that the work would finish quickly.

items.uz: Bolalar to'g'ri o'ssin uchun ularga g'amxo'rlik qildik.
items.en: We took care of the children so that they would grow up right.

items.uz: U meni kechirsin uchun uzr so'radim.
items.en: I apologized so that he/she would forgive me.

items.uz: Hamma xavfsiz bo'lsin uchun qoidalarga rioya qildik.
items.en: We followed the rules so that everyone would be safe.
I sat next to him/her so that he/she would calm down.
We planned so that the task would be easy.
